This design preserves the domain-specific strengths of the selected expert while allowing the router to refine, correct, or override expert behavior when necessary. Because the router and routing layer are trained on mixed-domain data, the complementary logits also help anchor generation to distributions observed during training, improving stability and robustness in settings where expert outputs alone are unreliable.
